comment: LivexaBot Universal Egg - Professional Hosting for Telegram Bots with FFmpeg
startup: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi; python {{START_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update && apt install -y git ffmpeg
cd /home/container
git clone https://github.com/inyogeshwar/livexa-telegram-automation.git .
pip install -r requirements.txt
